description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; each call uses one AI analysis from the licence quota. Turns notes or a transcript of a procurement conversation (for example with a supplier) into minutes for the buyer: summary, decisions, commitments with who, what and by when, open points, risks and a short follow-up email to the other party. Only what was said; no invented decisions, numbers or dates. The notes are processed for this answer only and are not stored by KULIC Advisory.

language.description: Language of the answer: de, en, fr, es, pt or zh. Default de.

meeting_type.description: Optional: type of conversation, e.g. 'annual price negotiation with packaging supplier'.

notes.description: Notes or transcript of the conversation.

name: write_meeting_minutes
title: Write minutes and commitments from notes of a supplier meeting (AICTIONBOT™ minutes)
